i.norm: Takes an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding. @param testValues an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding.
Tests rule 2: Translate last characters of name: EE → Y, IE → Y, DT, RT, RD, NT, ND → D
Rule 2a: trailing EE and IE both map to Y
Rule 2b: trailing DT, RT, RD, NT, ND all map to D
